Document ID: RM-DOC-0121
Headline: Explainer: how Brenmark's electronics reach Harrowgate
Publisher: Runewire
Date: 2024-11-15
Doc Type: explainer
Event_ID: background
Countries: Brenmark; Asvald; Gravia
Sectors: electronics
Reliability: 2

About half of Brenmark's electronics imports arrive through the Serpent Canal from Asvald and Gravia.

The rest comes from Corvenia over the Ironway Rail Link or by coastal feeder.
